changes: New: Paragraph formats — each paragraph has its own alignment, indents, bullet and spacing, from the ribbon's Paragraph group or the text editor.
New: Page tabs scroll — drawings with many pages keep every tab in reach.
MCP: picture.insert — place EMF, PNG or JPEG files; connectors take waypoints.
Fix: .vsdx drawings — text on flipped shapes, fill and dash patterns, line jumps and arrowheads as drawn.
Fix: Ctrl+= zooms the drawing — not the whole window; one swipe over the ribbon moves on one tab.
Fix: Palettes and AutoRecover — GIMP palettes and hex lists read right; the recovery copy follows a new folder.
